relevance: P1-6 payload XPath / P0-5 XPath criteria

raw.title: v6.7.0
raw.body:
## What's Changed
* docs(repo): add documentation as codeowners for toc.json by @heitortsergent in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2321
* docs(repo): update rulesets docs by @heitortsergent in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2310
* docs(repo): fix custom function examples with targetVal by @heitortsergent in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2322
* chore(deps): bump engine.io from 6.2.0 to 6.2.1 by @dependabot in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2347
* fix(core): improve deep ruleset inheritance by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2326
* docs(repo): add API Stylebook to README by @heitortsergent in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2346
* fix(ruleset-migrator): avoid positive lookbehinds by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2349
* feat(core): support end-user extensions in the rule definitions by @pavelkornev in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2345
* fix(rulesets): length.min said "must not be longer than" by @philsturgeon in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2355
* fix(ref-resolver): bump @stoplight/json-ref-resolver from ~3.1.4 to ~3.1.5 by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2365
* docs(repo): vale review by @heitortsergent in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2366
* docs(repo): add list of common aliases by @heitortsergent in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2320
* docs(repo): clarified installation steps for cli and core by @pamgoodrich in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2370
* docs(repo): added info about inherited overrides by @pamgoodrich in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2369
* fix(core): reset path in fn context by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2389
* chore(deps-dev): bump json5 from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 by @dependabot in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2379
* chore(deps): bump http-cache-semantics from 4.1.0 to 4.1.1 by @dependabot in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2393
* chore(deps): bump ua-parser-js from 0.7.31 to 0.7.33 by @dependabot in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2388
* fix(ruleset-migrator): use module for require.resolve by @dweber019 in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2405
* fix(ruleset-bundler): defaults should be last one by @dweber019 in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2403
* docs(repo): removed inconsistent quotation marks from toc.json by @thiagoschreck in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2409
* feat(core): support x- extensions in the ruleset by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2440
* docs(repo): add additional style guide examples to readme by @mnaumanali94 in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2449
* docs(repo): linting with ssgs by @pamgoodrich in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2450
* chore(deps): bump vm2 from 3.9.11 to 3.9.17 by @dependabot in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2458
* fix(ruleset-migrator): transform functions under overrides by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2459
* chore(deps-dev): bump xml2js from 0.4.23 to 0.5.0 by @dependabot in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2453
* feat(core): relax formats validation by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2151
* fix(core): more accurate ruleset error paths  by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2343
* feat(rulesets): add message traits array path to asyncapi headers schema type object rule by @CalemRoelofsSB in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2460
* chore(deps): bump vm2 from 3.9.17 to 3.9.19 by @dependabot in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2473
* fix(ruleset-bundler): remove extraneous 'external dependency' warnings by @billiegoose in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2475
* chore(cli): inline html templates in html formatter by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2474
* build(repo): use semantic-release-yarn for proper workspaces support by @P0lip in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2477
* feat(formatters): move formatters to a separate package by @sennyeya in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2468

## New Contributors
* @dweber019 made their first contribution in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2405
* @thiagoschreck made their first contribution in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2409
* @CalemRoelofsSB made their first contribution in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2460
* @sennyeya made their first contribution in https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/pull/2468

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stoplightio/spectral/compare/v6.6.0...v6.7.0
